svg.text: screening: every retained numeric row, fixed positive affine view
2259 original observations; every numeric row painted, including overlaps.
Original one-based birth-file ordinal; horizontal position = log10(ordinal)
Raw score ticks; vertical position = log10((f-m)/s+epsilon); epsilon = 1e-6.
No trajectory: accession order is not an admitted campaign/time sequence.
Lower original deficit preferred; 1 exact minimum ties. Ordinals identify source files.
Fixed full-source min/max and final reference; no physical ratios or cross-run ranking.
Unknown screen values are nonnumeric; full-range asinh and summary views are separate.
